blockOne.Source: Kool History From Abandoned Planets, Babylon Interests Vol. 154, Wastelander Interviews (All of them). Shortened for the reader's convenience.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: The origin of these beautiful skyscraper-sized copper beasts is unfortunately unknown. They're littered across apocalyptic worlds, wastelanders often use the hollow corpses of RSRC-MVRs to seek shelter or scavenge for mechanical parts. Known history and study show that these machines were built just to move whole civilizations, and it is widely inferred that they have all collapsed at some point together due to something we don't know of. Some wastelanders centuries later managed to fix and operate the machines through sheer effort, and so they've soon become a symbol for their kind as a whole. Grander civilizations refuse to use these simply due to missing proper blueprints and great costs to even operate these things on a massive scale.

It's difficult to tell the history of these machines. Many believe these were brought by an alien species from a whole different universe, but of course, that's ridiculous for many reasons. One thing that is known for sure is that these machines have been around for millennia, helping the New Babylon construct itself by hoarding and moving resources very slowly in it's young days. The New Babylon retired these machines later, yet many more remain on apocalyptic worlds for unknown reasons. It's ability to work off solar energy helps it keep relevancy instead of being forgotten about due to being too inefficient. This machine earned its title of being the wastelanders' icon, mainly due to helping them survive through the harshest times.

This walker is made of hollow metal, just like most other machines out there. What makes it unique however is its thick copper plating. Without a closer it looks like it was made completely out of copper, boasting both orange and cyan colors for the whole world to see. The cyan colors come from weathering, forgotten walkers are completely cyan with most of the copper plating fallen off revealing their gray inner skin. Traditions among the wastelanders run where the weathering of the RSRC-MVRs are manipulated to paint shapes and patterns on its plating. Some places are kept clean, shiny and orange, whilst some are purposefully kept to weather and gain a distinct cyan color. This technique is also used to form numbers on it to easily identify it from far distances.

At first glance it may seem like running this machine may take too much effort, but surprisingly, it's flexible to bounds no one thought of. It's powered off solar and wind energy, allowing it to power its terminal with enough fixing. There are many automated drones that resembles crabs hidden within the walker, their main purpose to fix a minor problem that occurs. The main core of the walker is powered by large batteries which can be ejected and taken out to charge through different sources rather than wind or solar. These batteries are highly explosive, yet some have exploited that and purposefully ejected the batteries at their foes via makeshift cannons.

Many people believe this walker can just walk, but it can also run during emergencies. It has a strange, animalistic design that from distances you'd believe there was a large mechanical camel roaming the surface. It's limbs, head, neck, anything can be controlled and in the worst cases they can be given self-control with its shoddy artificial intelligence.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Designed roughly at the same time as other logistic related craft in an effort to properly expand by building structures and supporting combat craft by being able to repair or tow them away. It was noted its evasive and nimble nature and a combat version was created named 'Incendiary Hourglass' its results were mixed but it remains in the blueprint database. the hourglasses hull though still is the subject of talk of making various versions of this craft.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: It has to do as much with moles as it has to do with bread, literally nothing. A small sized family of submarines designed for survival and endurance as they slowly whittle down their enemies.

First iteration of the mole bread was created for a tournament where 4 people had to construct a vessel and fight against each other to death. Anyway it never ended up happening as it was against the law and all 4 craft were confiscated and the people detained. Although all 4 craft were considerably shitty they have been analyzed and the mole bread actually seemed worth something. Not in terms of quality nonono the torpedoes, half of them didn't even function which one of them exploded injuring 3 personal. The engine has been found faulty and not properly vented which would have led to the driver suffocation in a matter of hours. And it was made half out of wood for goodness sake! It's hull got completely revamped internals also replaced until it actually could be used in a regular manner. The origin of this name is also something spectacular, when it was confiscated and held in a dry dock for the first time it didn't have any name and with a brown wooden cover and a two rods sticking out, on one end a rather outdated and taped together sonar and on the other an equally ineffective torpedo decoy. It got pointed out on multiple occasions that it looks like a piece of bread by various employees who were working on the retrofit at that time. And during one morning two eyes could be seen on it. Someone managed to spray paint googly eyes on it the night before as a prank. And thus it earned its name as the mole bread. Management at first confused with this occurrence but later adopted the mole bread name in its database as it's become wide spread already. On the redesign eyes were included on its original location, the metal painted brown to remind them of the bread looking wooden hull it used to have.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: A medium sized assault submarine armed with a devastating dual chain-cannon also a home to one of the most unusual restaurants. Designed with a more cost effective stone inner armor and unusual turret design and placement. Most known for it's rather gruesome and uncanny design of the front side turret and the devastating storm of high velocity HEAT shells going so fast they damage the outer armor meantime the HEAT works on the internal components. The downside of this beast is Its hungry attitude as its melts away enemies and fuel alike.

Already when first introduced the Abyssalite made its presence known both by sheer destruction of other helpless craft ill-equipped to deal with underwater threats, its great fighting chance against more lethal targets and of course Its Fuel hungry nature and volatile components. blockTwo.heading: Incident_000 24/8/2643 04:32
paragraphs: During maintenance autoloader jammed mechanic currently working there reportedly tried hitting the jammed shell to get it unstuck the shell jerked back into the system fast almost causing a chain reaction. There were no deaths or injuries. Mechanic in question was later fired and charged.

blockTwo.heading: Incident_001 2/10/2643 13:54
paragraphs: Unknown engine malfunction occurred causing the submarine to halt. Due to the malfunction the vessels arrival was delayed by approximately 2 hours.

blockTwo.heading: Incident_002 5/4/2644 19:03
paragraphs: A murder occurred In the Deep Trench Restaurant suspect wearing long red dress going from the neck approximately ending on the knees, Suspect was seen wearing an unusual white helmet with a V shape with two holes serving as viewports. Suspect killed 21 year old [REDACTED] and proceeded to drink his blood out of a glass, afterwards suspect ran away and vanished. Security was not called. Upon arrival at the port everyone on the submarine was ordered to not leave upon further notice. Special operatives were called to search thru the submarine and its subsystems suspect was not found. Everyone was let go except witnesses which were questioned.

blockTwo.heading: Incident_003 16/4/2644 09:34
paragraphs: A rock got stuck in the submarines sonar obscuring vision Diving team was dispatched and in 30 minutes the vessel could continue moving.
